fields.Name: Start Diagnostic Session
fields.Description: Starts a bounded diagnostic recording session targeting users, API keys, operations, a browser session, or the instance. Implemented by DiagnosticsStartSessionServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Stop Diagnostic Session
fields.Description: Stops an active diagnostic session immediately and broadcasts a multi-instance flush so all server nodes write their pending chunks. Implemented by DiagnosticsStopSessionServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Get My Diagnostic Session Status
fields.Description: Returns whether the calling user or browser session is currently targeted by an active diagnostic recording session, plus whether self-service recording is enabled. Implemented by DiagnosticsGetMySessionStatusServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Upload Client Diagnostic Capture
fields.Description: Uploads client-side flight-recorder buffers (logs, GraphQL waterfall, telemetry, startup marks, reproduction notes) into a diagnostic session as re-scrubbed compressed chunks. Implemented by DiagnosticsUploadClientCaptureServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Build Diagnostic Bundle
fields.Description: Flushes all participating server instances, assembles session chunks into a .mjdiag ZIP archive, runs the two-stage credential/literal scrubber and automated findings engine, verifies the archive with VerifyBundleArchive, and persists the bundle. Implemented by DiagnosticsBuildBundleServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Get Diagnostic Bundle Preview
fields.Description: Returns a diagnostic bundle's manifest, scrubbing summary, README text, automated findings, and an optional short-lived single-use signed download token. Implemented by DiagnosticsGetBundlePreviewServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Send Diagnostic Bundle
fields.Description: Encrypts a verified .mjdiag bundle using X25519+HKDF-SHA256+AES-256-GCM with AAD and transmits it to an allowed external destination (MJC, CustomerCollector, or StorageAccount). Implemented by DiagnosticsSendBundleServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Issue Diagnostic Sender Registration Code
fields.Description: Issues a one-time registration code for a MJ: Diagnostic Sender Registrations row on this collector: 32 random bytes as base64url, valid for 24 hours. Only the SHA-256 hash is stored; the plain code is returned once. Requires the Diagnostics: Manage Intake authorization. Implemented by DiagnosticsIssueSenderRegistrationCodeServerOperation in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Enrol Diagnostic Sender
fields.Description: Enrols this installation as a sender with the collector at Diagnostics.External.CollectorUrl using a one-time registration code: generates an Ed25519 key pair, stores the private key in MJ: Credentials, proves possession of the key to the collector and pins the collector's public keys. Requires the Diagnostics: Manage Intake authorization. Implemented in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Revoke Diagnostic Sender
fields.Description: Revokes a sender registration on this collector: sets the MJ: Diagnostic Sender Registrations row to Revoked, sets RevokedAt, and clears any outstanding registration code. Requires the Diagnostics: Manage Intake authorization. Implemented in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.

fields.Name: Reactivate Diagnostic Sender
fields.Description: Sets a Revoked sender registration that still has an enrolled key back to Active. A registration without a key needs a new registration code instead. Requires the Diagnostics: Manage Intake authorization. Implemented in @memberjunction/diagnostics-server.
